scripts.dev:api: npm run build:domain && npm --workspace api run start:dev
scripts.dev:api:migrated: npm run migrate:api && npm run dev:api
scripts.dev: echo "Run dev:api and dev:mobile in separate terminals"
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @cortege/ibp-domain run typecheck && npm --workspace mobile run typecheck && npm --workspace api run build
scripts.test:unit: npm --workspace @cortege/ibp-domain run test && npm --workspace api run test:unit && npm --workspace mobile run test:unit
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:coverage:api: npm --workspace api run test:unit:coverage && npm --workspace api run test:e2e:coverage
